summary: Iter24 tested (A) backend action-item snapshot endpoints on project 5e275c28 and (B) frontend live-sync + Photos sticky header + Overview readiness sync. Backend: all four mutating endpoints (POST /items, PUT /items/{i}, PATCH /items/{i}/confirm, POST /items/confirm-all) return the required snapshot keys {itemsBeforeIssue, readiness, measures, completion}. Test item created was successfully deleted via DELETE /items/{raw_index} (index 12), leaving project unchanged.
